cases.question: What are the ids and names of the battles that led to more than 10 people died.
cases.gold: SELECT T1.id ,  T1.name FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.lost_in_battle JOIN death AS T3 ON T2.id  =  T3.caused_by_ship_id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING sum(T3.killed)  >  10
cases.sql_gated: SELECT T1.id , T1.name FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.lost_in_battle JOIN death AS T3 ON T2.id  =  T3.caused_by_ship_id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING sum(T3.killed)  >  10
cases.sql_zs:
SELECT DISTINCT b.id, b.name
FROM battle b
JOIN ship s ON b.id = s.lost_in_battle
JOIN death d ON s.id = d.caused_by_ship_id
WHERE d.killed > 10

cases.question: How many nations has more than 2 car makers ?
cases.gold: select count(*) from countries as t1 join car_makers as t2 on t1.countryid  =  t2.country group by t1.countryid having count(*)  >  2
cases.sql_gated: SELECT count(*) FROM car_makers GROUP BY Country HAVING count(*) > 2
cases.sql_zs:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nation_count
FROM (
    SELECT c.CountryId, c.CountryName
    FROM countries c
    JOIN car_makers cm ON c.CountryId = cm.Country
    GROUP BY c.CountryId, c.CountryName
    HAVING COUNT(cm.Id) > 2
) AS subquery

cases.question: What are the different models created by either General Motors or over 3500 lbs?

SELECT DISTINCT m.Model
FROM model_list m
JOIN car_makers cm ON m.Maker = cm.Id
JOIN cars_data cd ON m.Model = cd.Id
WHERE cm.FullName = 'General Motors' OR cd.Weight > 3500
cases.sql_zs:
SELECT DISTINCT ml.Model
FROM model_list ml
JOIN car_makers cm ON ml.Maker = cm.Id
JOIN car_names cn ON ml.Model = cn.Model

cases.question: What are the ids and names of all countries that either have more than 3 car makers or produce fiats?
cases.gold: select t1.countryid ,  t1.countryname from countries as t1 join car_makers as t2 on t1.countryid  =  t2.country group by t1.countryid having count(*)  >  3 union select t1.countryid ,  t1.countryname from countries as t1 join car_makers as t2 on t1.countryid  =  t2.country join model_list as t3 on t2.id  =  t3.maker where t3.model  =  'fiat';
cases.sql_gated:
SELECT T1.CountryId ,  T1.CountryName
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.CountryId  =  T2.Country
WHERE T1.CountryId IN (
    SELECT T3.Country
    FROM car_makers AS T3
    GROUP BY T3.Country
    HAVING count(*) > 3
)
OR T2.Maker = 'fiat'
cases.sql_zs:
SELECT c.CountryId, c.CountryName
FROM countries c
WHERE (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM car_makers cm
    WHERE cm.Country = c.CountryId
) > 3
OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM car_makers cm
    JOIN model_list ml ON cm.Id = ml.Maker
    WHERE cm.Country = c.CountryId
    AND ml.Model = 'fiat'
)

flash.final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ml.Model
FROM cars_data c
JOIN car_names cn ON c.Id = cn.MakeId
JOIN model_list ml ON cn.Model = ml.Model
JOIN car_makers cm ON ml.Maker = cm.Id
WHERE c.Weight < 3500
AND cm.FullName != 'Ford Motor Company'

JOIN model_list AS T3 ON T1.Id  =  T3.Maker
